commercial_product.note: West Pharmaceutical Services manufactures and sells components and delivery systems for injectable drugs (elastomer stoppers/seals, syringes, self-injection systems such as the SmartDose platform, vial-to-bag transfer systems). Customers are pharma/biotech sponsors. West does not develop its own NCEs and has no company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adjacent medtech/packaging supplier - no proprietary clinical pipeline. West sells primary packaging components (elastomer closures, seals) and delivery devices (e.g. SmartDose wearable injector, Daikyo Crystal Zenith containers) to pharma customers. No company-sponsored therapeutic P1/P2/P3 programs.
